thread:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only deploy: soft-config-traffic-shim-v2 -> canary (5%) across us-west-2. Changes: routing priority shuffle, batch_window_ms, per-route timeout tweaks. rollout_id=rc-2025-04-08-01
liam: quick heads-up: this is non-code. target is latency-sensitive routing for small requests. keep an eye on p50/p95.
nina: oncall ack. will monitor traces and error budget dashboard. pls post the rollout command output.
deploy-bot: rollout command:
```
redwoodctl rollout apply --id rc-2025-04-08-01 --type config-only --targets canary=5 --manifest /manifests/soft-config-traffic-shim-v2.yaml
```
deploy-bot: manifest diff (summary):
- routing.route_priority: LOW -> MEDIUM
- routing.fallback_policy: regional -> global
- batching.batch_window_ms: 8 -> 12
- limits.max_concurrent_per_token: 6 -> 4
- timeouts.request_timeout_ms: 60000 -> 45000

sam: noted the concurrency drop and shorter timeout. that could cut cost but might surface tail errors on long-gen flows. recommendation: keep observation window 15m after canary starts.
liam: agreed. nina, set alert for tail latency > 20% from baseline and 5xx spike > 1.5x. also enable slow_request_trace sampling.
nina: alerts wired. enabling traces now.
(2 minutes later)
deploy-bot: canary applied to 5% hosts. health checks: passing. no traffic anomalies in first 60s.
amanda: product note: this should reduce billing for short assistant pings. tracking expected drop in token-cost per call ~6%.
(5 minutes later)
deploy-bot: metrics @ 5m:
- p50 latency: +2%
- p95 latency: +12%
- 5xx rate: 1.1x baseline
- avg batch size: 1.8 -> 2.3
sam: p95 +12% is borderline but within SLO headroom. watch for p95 > 20% or 5xx >= 2x.
liam: if p95 crosses 20% or 5xx >=2x within next 10m, prepare rollback plan. otherwise proceed to ramp to 20% at 30m.
nina: seeing a handful of tail timeouts from a subset of hosts (hostpool-13). digging in.
(3 minutes later)
nina: hostpool-13 has higher kernel scheduling latencies due to noisy VM. isolating and cordoning 2 instances from canary.
deploy-bot: cordon applied to hostpool-13 instances. traffic redistributed.
deploy-bot: metrics @ 12m:
- p95 latency: +7%
- 5xx rate: 1.05x baseline
- error traces: majority from cordoned hosts (confirmed)
sam: good catch. given cordon fix improved p95 back to acceptable, recommend continuing ramp to 20%.
liam: proceed with scheduled ramp to 20% in 10m. ensure monitoring and ops channel pinned.
amanda: adding note to release tracker: "soft-config-traffic-shim-v2: decrease concurrency, tighten request timeout, increase batch window - expected cost ↓, small p95 increase risk". linking eval run id: eval-3312.
(10 minutes later)
deploy-bot: ramp to 20% started. health checks passing.
(6 minutes later)
deploy-bot: metrics @ 6m into 20%:
- p50: baseline +1%
- p95: baseline +9%
- 5xx rate: baseline *1.08
- tail timeouts: down to baseline levels
sam: still good. but one datapoint: per-route 95th for reranker pipeline had +30% on one region. tagging eng-runtime.
liam: eng-runtime please investigate reranker spike, region eu-west-1. nina, keep tracing enabled.
(eng-runtime ping)
eng-runtime: looking. found a hotspot in quantized kernel selection causing longer setup times for short-seq rerank. tracing details posted in #eng-runtime. suggested short-term mitigation: tweak routing to prefer cold-start warm hosts for rerank route.
liam: do the mitigation as a config change (not rollback). sam, can we push that in the same rollout as a patch?
sam: yes, we can apply a narrow route pin for reranker to use warm hosts only. minimal blast radius.
liam: okay roll that as rc-2025-04-08-01a. deploy-bot, apply patch to canary 5% then mirror to 20% once stable.
deploy-bot: applying rc-2025-04-08-01a to canary 5%...
deploy-bot: patch diff:
- routing.route_overrides["/rerank"].host_selector: any -> warm-only
- no other changes
deploy-bot: patch applied. monitoring...
(4 minutes later)
deploy-bot: post-patch metrics:
- rerank p95 (eu-west-1): returned to baseline
- overall p95: +6%
- 5xx: baseline *1.02
sam: mitigation successful. recommend continuing full rollout to 80% tomorrow morning during low-traffic window. add canary notes to the release doc.
liam: adding to release doc: "canary observations: transient host noise, fixed via cordon; reranker cold-start spike mitigated via warm-only override; overall p95 increase within SLOs; recommend full rollout in maintenance window 04/09 03:00-06:00 UTC. rollback plan attached."
amanda: I'll update customer-facing release notes with the cost-savings bullet and add a small callout about possible small latency changes for large multi-pass rerank requests.
liam: closing thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
